japanese-kana.swsh: ダイマックスした　ポケモンが くりだす　ほのおタイプの　こうげき。 ５ターンの　あいだ　ひざしを　つよくする。

korean.swsh: 다이맥스한 포켓몬이 날리는 불꽃타입의 공격. 5턴 동안 햇살을 강하게 만든다.

traditional-chinese.swsh: 極巨化寶可夢 所使出的火屬性攻擊。 可在５回合內讓日照增強。

french.swsh: Une attaque de type Feu que seuls les Pokémon Dynamax peuvent utiliser. Fait briller le soleil pendant cinq tours.

german.swsh: Eine Feuer-Attacke, die nur Dynamax-Pokémon einsetzen können. Die Sonne brennt unbarmherzig fünf Runden lang.

spanish.swsh: Ataque de tipo Fuego ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Hace que se intensifique el efecto del sol durante cinco turnos.

italian.swsh: Un attacco di tipo Fuoco che può essere eseguito dai Pokémon dynamaxizzati. Intensifica i raggi solari per cinque turni.

english.swsh: This is a Fire-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user intensifies the sun for five turns.

japanese.swsh: ダイマックスした　ポケモンが 繰りだす　ほのおタイプの　攻撃。 ５ターンの　間　日差しを　強くする。

simplified-chinese.swsh: 极巨化宝可梦使出的火属性攻击。 可在５回合内让日照变得强烈。

latin-american-spanish.swsh: Ataque de tipo Fuego ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Hace que se intensifique el efecto del sol durante cinco turnos.

effect.full: Changes the weather to sunshine for five turns, during which Fire moves inflict 50% extra damage, and Water moves inflict half damage. If the user is holding Heat Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns. Pokémon cannot become frozen. Thunder has 50% accuracy. Solar Beam skips its charge turn. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal 2/3 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Chlorophyll have doubled original Speed. Pokémon with Forecast become Fire. Pokémon with Leaf Guard are not affected by major status effects. Pokémon with Flower Gift change form; every Pokémon on their side of the field have their original Attack and Special Attack increased by 50%. Pokémon with Dry Skin lose 1/8 max HP at the end of each turn. Pokémon with Solar Power have their original Special Attack raised by 50% but lose 1/8 their max HP at the end of each turn.
effect.shortEffect: Changes the weather to sunny for five turns.
